## Summary

Describe the change and link the task proposal or bug report when applicable.

## Scope

- [ ] Documentation or contributor experience
- [ ] Task or verifier
- [ ] Adapter or packaging
- [ ] Other (describe above)

## Contract and evidence (for task or scoring changes)

- What intermediate observation constrains which later action?
- What are the validity and integrity conditions, and how does the verifier check them?
- Which compliant and violating trajectories did you review?
- Does this change affect the interpretation or comparability of existing scores?

## Reproduction

List the repository commit, proposed task name or existing task version, agent or oracle, command, and relevant redacted result. For documentation-only changes, state that no runtime behavior changed.

## Checklist

- [ ] I checked that the change matches the linked proposal or issue, if applicable.
- [ ] I removed credentials and private data from examples and logs.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation and identified any scoring-version impact.
